hypothesis: For the interim V9 parent, applying the rank-4 correction only when the cycle050 causal prefix contains at least 40 saved frames will strictly improve aggregate relative L2 on fresh group-disjoint train confirmation records.
mechanism: use the source-period-normalized cycle050 causal prefix
abstain exactly to the parent when fewer than 40 frames are visible
otherwise solve the frozen rank-4 closed-form residual inverse problem
apply at most five percent future correction energy

accuracy_and_selection.confirmation_pass: guarded adapted aggregate relative L2 must be strictly below the same-record frozen parent aggregate; no minimum percentage

rollback: minimum-observation abstention and every rejected solve return the immutable interim V9 checkpoint exactly
claim_scope: interim parent train-only confirmation; cannot promote or replace the final V9 decision
